label: new_boot_state
command: set -eu; sha256sum /lib/firmware/ai_sys.bin /root/tcp_image_rx/tcp_image_server; cat /sys/class/fpga_manager/fpga0/state; systemctl is-active tcp-image-server plbram plbdma; journalctl -u ai-sys-bitstream -b --no-pager; journalctl -u tcp-image-server -b --no-pager | grep -E "axil|vis|pp\]" ; grep -E "pl0_ref " /sys/kernel/debug/clk/clk_summary; ss -ltnp
